summary: Unbound: no permitted content-bound committed 8–64 GPU L40S topology term prices mandatory ancillary components or binds restart semantics; the available $0.8581222/hour record is preemptible experimental VM-plus-disk and explicitly excludes public IPv4/egress.
next_action: Do not claim L40S production COGS from the GPU-only planning rate. Reopen only if a matching content-bound committed topology term binds CPU/RAM, persistent storage, network/egress, control/support, billing minima, and interruption/restart semantics.
decision_reason: The GPU-only $1.10/hour planning rate leaves $0.013384/hour (8h) or $0.045885/hour (24h) for every mandatory ancillary component, but no allowed evidence bounds those costs or the restart count.
